author: ETA PRIME
description:
I Built A SFF Budget Gaming PC using Aliexpress Parts! With PC hardware prices out of control, I wanted to see how cheaply we could put together a small form factor (SFF) custom gaming PC using parts from Amazon and AliExpress. By pairing a Minisforum AMD Ryzen 7 7745HX MoDT motherboard combo inside a $29 slim case with a $131 ASRock Intel Arc A380 6GB Low Profile GPU, we've got a super compact rig—but to really make it shine at 1080p, we have to unlock the GPU's 43W power limit.
